scenarios: two approved protected effects produce a hash-linked two-receipt chain bound to approval/lease/call/result; tampering a stored field, reordering the two receipts, and deleting the first each make chain verification fail, and restoring makes it pass
proof: high-risk effects seal an immutable hash-linked receipt bound to approval/capability/call/result; GetEffectReceipts recomputes verify_chain over the stored rows on every read, so tamper/delete/reorder is detected.
audit: PARTIAL before: the Effect Ledger (M2.5/M2.8) built the chain, seal/verify_chain and GetEffectReceipts; the real-system tamper/delete/reorder qualification (QUAL-EV-0270) was missing.
limitations: per-tenant chain; projection tamper self-heals on rebuild (the log is truth, hash-chained by M1.1); whole-chain verification per read.
